subject: Request: temporary latency tolerance & reduced uptime SLA for Harbor Tech pilot
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@harbortech.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot request + SLA questions

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks again for the demo — Harbor Tech is excited to move a pilot forward for our mortgage document ingestion pipeline. Our procurement team has a couple of constraints before they can sign: they want a temporary relaxation on the uptime target for the first 90 days of the pilot and an adjusted latency SLO for p95 (we're seeing long tails with our OCR bursts). Specifically they're asking for:

- Uptime target of 99.5% (instead of standard 99.9%) for first 90 days
- p95 latency target of 750ms for document generation endpoints during the pilot window
- A cap on service credits for any outage/latency breach (Procurement proposal: 5% of monthly commitment)

They also requested a pilot discount and prefer a 20% concession on committed GPU capacity for the initial quarter. Attached is the RFP excerpt and a short procurement checklist.

Can your team confirm whether Redwood can accept these temporary terms, and what guardrails you'd want in place (telemetry, API rate limits, fallback model variant, etc)? Procurement would like a written amendment and exec approval if the deal desk doesn’t have latitude to approve.

Best,
Alyssa
Director, Cloud Integrations
Harbor Tech

Attachments: Harbor_Tech_RFP.pdf

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@harbortech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot request + SLA questions

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the clear ask and the RFP excerpt. We can support a pilot with adjusted targets but this requires a limited non-standard concession and legal amendment; I’m looping in Deal Desk (Ben), Sales Ops (Marissa), and Legal (Lauren) to assess risks and confirm signoff authority.

High-level proposal from my side (what we'd take to exec/deal desk):
- Pilot term: 90 days.
- Uptime: 99.5% for pilot only, revert to contract 99.9% after pilot.
- Latency: allow p95 up to 750ms for document generation endpoints during pilot; require SLIs and telemetry available to both parties.
- Service credits: capped at 5% of monthly committed spend for pilot period.
- Commercial concession: 20% one-quarter discount on committed capacity; any extension requires normal pricing.
- Guardrails: enable prefix-KV caching for repeated jobs, telemetry dashboard access to Harbor (read-only), automatic fallback to smaller model variant after sustained tail latency.

If Deal Desk / Exec approves, we’ll produce a one-page amendment + DocuSign addendum and a telemetry/runbook for the pilot. Please confirm any non-negotiable legal clauses from your side.

Thanks,
Nikhil
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pilot request + SLA questions

Nikhil — thanks for the write-up. Quick internal notes from Deal Desk:

- Risk/Exposure: Harbor is a mid-market prospect but strategically useful for our mortgage vertical playbook. A 20% concession for the first quarter is material; recommend we counter at 15% unless Marketing funds part of the discount.
- Uptime: Approve 99.5% for 90 days provided the credit cap is 5% and that we require a runbook + weekly telemetry review.
- Latency: Approve p95 750ms for pilot only if we instrument a strict alerting threshold (p95 > 1s triggers escalation to Ops).
- Commercial: Require commitment to a minimum baseline (3 months paid) and clause that normal SLA/pricing reinstates after pilot.

I’ve flagged the HubSpot deal and added proposed amendment text. Links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890

Ben
Head of Deal Desk

(Attachment: suggested redline language pasted into HubSpot as deal note)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pilot request + SLA questions

Agree with Ben. Endorsing approval with edits:

- Concession: 15% pilot discount instead of 20% (we can top up marketing credits if needed).
- Keep credit cap at 5% for pilot, require indemnity language for any catastrophic data incidents.
- Request Nikhil to produce a one-pager (1 side) that lists technical guardrails, telemetry endpoints, and escalation contacts — this will be what I sign off on.

If legal signs off on the amended indemnity language and procurement accepts the 15% concession, I will provide exec approval for the non-standard SLA.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pilot request + SLA questions (legal redlines)

Marissa / Ben — attaching proposed amendment and two legal notes: 1) add explicit scope limiting the relaxed SLA to the named pilot endpoints and time window; 2) cap cumulative credits at 5% of MRR and add a mutual termination right if repeated breaches occur. Also added telemetry/data access and retention clauses.

Attachment: SLA_Amendment_HarborTech_v1.docx

Legal is comfortable with the 5% cap and the time-boxed concession; we should avoid precedent by adding clear language that this is a one-time, non-precedential pilot concession.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot request + SLA questions — Exec endorsement

All — after reviewing the amendment and commercial impact, I approve the pilot concession with the following final terms:

- Pilot window: 90 days (start on contract execution)
- Uptime: 99.5% for pilot only
- Latency: p95 up to 750ms, with automatic alerting at 1s and Ops escalation process
- Service credits: capped at 5% of monthly committed spend for pilot (cumulative cap applies)
- Commercial: 15% discount on Q1 committed capacity (marketing to cover 5% of the concession if Sales Ops requests)
- One-page telemetry/runbook required and shared with Harbor before pilot kickoff

Nikhil — please update the HubSpot deal with these terms, send the amended DocuSign to Alyssa and copy legal (Lauren). Once signed, Ops and I will schedule a short kickoff and weekly telemetry reviews for the pilot.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales (approved)
